title.zh-CN: 从数据到可泛化的程序
title.en: From Data to Programs That Generalize

description.zh-CN: 一份连续的中文入门课件，从问题与数据出发，逐步讨论模型如何表示预测、损失如何定义目标、梯度如何驱动学习，以及如何用独立数据检验泛化。沿同一份二维带噪 XOR 数据，把机器学习基础、反向传播与核方法联系起来。
description.en: One continuous introductory presentation in Chinese develops the discussion from a problem and data to models, losses, gradient-based learning and independent checks of generalization. Follow one noisy two-dimensional XOR dataset to connect machine learning foundations, backpropagation and kernel methods.

summary.zh-CN: 先说明任务、样本与标签，再追问：程序需要记住已有数据，还是预测尚未见过的样本？
summary.en: Define the task, examples and labels, then ask whether the program should remember existing data or predict unseen examples.

summary.zh-CN: 用参数化函数表达预测，区分 logit、概率与决策，再用损失把“预测得好”变成可计算的目标。
summary.en: Represent predictions with a parameterized function, distinguish logits, probabilities and decisions, and turn a good prediction into a computable objective.

summary.zh-CN: 从单个导数走到矩阵梯度与训练循环，检查学习率和优化过程，定位线性模型的表示边界。
summary.en: Develop matrix gradients and a training loop from a single derivative, inspect learning rates and optimization, and locate the limits of a linear representation.

summary.zh-CN: 从手工交互特征走向网络学习的表示；沿计算图推导局部梯度，解释梯度如何汇总、共享并传回参数。
summary.en: Move from hand-crafted interaction features to learned representations; derive local gradients through a computation graph and explain how they accumulate and flow back to parameters.

summary.zh-CN: 把特征映射、内积与相似度连在一起，理解核如何隐式表达非线性，以及 SVM 的间隔目标。
summary.en: Connect feature maps, inner products and similarity to understand implicit nonlinear representations and the margin objective of SVMs.

summary.zh-CN: 在同一任务上比较候选表示与模型，用验证数据作选择，最后用独立测试数据检查泛化。
summary.en: Compare candidate representations and models on the same task, select with validation data, and check generalization with independent test data at the end.

summary.zh-CN: 回到表示、目标、优化和泛化这条共同主线，为理解 CS224N 与 CS336 中更大的模型建立连接。
summary.en: Return to the shared thread of representations, objectives, optimization and generalization, preparing for the larger models studied in CS224N and CS336.

subtitle.zh-CN: 机器学习基础 · 反向传播 · 核方法
subtitle.en: Machine Learning Foundations · Backpropagation · Kernel Methods
